## Interactive model

<!-- One sentence: what the application shows and what to try. Then OJS cells:
       1. imports from ../js/models.js (//| echo: false)
       2. viewof controls; a "Random seed" slider when there are random draws
       3. pure computation
       4. Plot.plot (starting with ariaLabel and ariaDescription) or
          drawGrid(..., {ariaLabel, ariaDescription})
       5. readout: html`<div class="sim-readout">${md`...`}</div>`
     Agent-based entries: the live cells replay one run (player() to step
     through it), then a "### NetLogo experiment" subsection loads
     FileAttachment("../data/<slug>.csv").csv({typed: true}), charts the
     sweep and has its own readout. Defaults must show the model's point. -->

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import {rng, fmt, C} from "../js/models.js"
```

```{ojs}
viewof seed = Inputs.range([1, 500], {value: 1, step: 1, label: "Random seed"})
```

```{ojs}
sim = rng(seed).normals(100).map((y, i) => ({i, y}))
```

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  ariaLabel: "Model Name: chart",
  ariaDescription: "What the axes show. The summary below the chart states the result in words.",
  height: 260,
  marks: [Plot.dot(sim, {x: "i", y: "y", fill: C.teal})]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div class="sim-readout">${md`The result, in words, with **${fmt(1.23)}** numbers.`}</div>`
```
